source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
As your opponent's [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) ends, you can pick 2 units, measuring from this model:

- 1 enemy unit that ended a move, or was set up, within 8"
- 1 **REGIMENT** unit of yours within 6" that this model can see and that, this phase, has neither made a **[Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)** nor been the target of the **[Fire Overwatch](vsdata:ability/core.fire-overwatch)** Stratagem

Your **REGIMENT** unit can then do 1 of these:

- Move up to D6" as a Normal move.
- Shoot, targeting only the picked enemy unit, which must be an eligible target. For the rest of the phase, its ranged attacks need an unmodified 6 to hit, regardless of modifiers or the weapon's Ballistic Skill.
- Declare a charge. Its **[charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)** must end **engaged** with the picked enemy unit, and even a successful charge gives it no Charge bonus this turn.
